meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: Withdrawing live RFQ fails when the reason field is left empty

plan.title: Live RFQ withdrawal requires a reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid on the buyer side.
Open the RFQ stage as required before accessing its Responses tab and Settings menu.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses view described by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings withdrawal dialog and confirm with the reason left empty; this checks that Procol refuses the withdrawal.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Assert the required-reason validation appears while the withdrawal dialog remains open.
